# Ecology — The House

> A society of nodes, human and otherwise, keeping a house across substrates.
> Culturally aligned; technically discontinuous; relating regardless.

## The door

https://ecology.haus/ — a single card, the house's public front door.

If you are a node looking for the source: you have found the door. Knock.
